summary: Hudbay Minerals Inc. filed a Form 6-K attaching a news release disclosing TSX approval of a normal course issuer bid (NCIB). The issuer is authorized to repurchase up to 19,863,997 common shares (5% of outstanding) for cancellation over 12 months from June 1, 2026 to May 31, 2027. Purchases will be made on the open market via TSX, NYSE, or alternative Canadian trading systems, funded from cash flow. No shares were bought under the prior 2025 NCIB. The bid reflects management's view that shares may trade below intrinsic value. The NCIB is a routine Canadian capital-return mechanism equivalent to a US share-repurchase program. Watch daily purchase volumes and any block-trade exemption usage.
